name: cx-playground-gate
description: Dev-only dependencies for scripts/test_playground_mermaid.mjs — the gate that parses every diagram the playground can emit under the SAME mermaid major the playground page loads from its CDN (see the <script> tag in scripts/gen_guide/playground/playground.html). Pinned to the major, not the patch, so the gate tracks what visitors actually get. jsdom supplies the document mermaid's parser reaches for.
